notes.quote: This question involved two integrals, one by parts, the second via a given substitution.
Candidates should have been well prepared for such a question, Part (i) required the candidates to use integration by parts twice on 2 ex x .
It is a well-known technique and most made very good progress.
It was common to see an sign error when performing the second integration losing one of the 4 marks.

The substitution in part(ii) was more demanding, but still a standard integration technique. There were some very good answers to this question but common errors that need to be addressed by future cohorts are:
